I can do that, but I need a few clarifications before I remove anything — this is a destructive action, so I’ll wait for your explicit confirmation.

1) Which dates do you mean by “next week”? I can assume Monday–Sunday of the upcoming week (Mon Jul 13–Sun Jul 19, 2026), but please confirm or give exact start/end dates.

2) Which events count as “meetings”?
- Option A: any event that has other attendees (invitations)
- Option B: only events you organized
- Option C: all events (including one-person items)
Tell me which option you want (A, B, or C), or describe another rule.

3) How should I handle recurring meetings that fall in that range?
- Delete only the instances in that week, or
- Cancel/delete the entire recurring series

4) When removing meetings that include other people, do you want me to:
- Send cancellations/notifications to attendees (recommended), or
- Just remove them from your calendar without notifying attendees

5) Which calendar should I modify if you have more than one (work, personal, etc.)?

What I will do once you confirm these details and explicitly authorize deletion:
- Identify matching events in the specified calendar and date range
- (If you asked) send cancellations to attendees or remove the events locally
- I will not proceed until you reply
